subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

**For certain**, this is the best pizza in town.

options.text: Beyond a shadow of a doubt

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Beyond a shadow of a doubt"** means something that is absolutely certain or without any doubt. (बिल्कुल निश्चित)

 
 
• **Example: **She proved beyond a shadow of a doubt that she was innocent.
 
 
 
• **"For certain"** refers to something that is known for sure; without any doubt. (निश्चित रूप से)
 
 
• **Example: **I know for **certain **that I left my keys on the table.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **'For certain'** can be substituted by **'Beyond a shadow of a doubt'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Through thick and thin** (हर परिस्थिति में): In both good and bad times.

 
 
• **Example:** She stood by him through thick and thin.
 
 
 
• **Benefit of doubt** (संदेह का लाभ): Accepting someone as honest or innocent because there is no proof otherwise.
 
 
• **Example:** The jury gave the defendant the benefit of the doubt.
 
 
 
• **Off on the wrong foot** (गलत शुरुआत): To start something in a negative or bad way.
 
 
• **Example:** Their relationship got off on the wrong foot.

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
